newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements (RPs) Wednesday.
The Fed's reserve additions in the second week of this settlement period have exceeded Morgan Guaranty Trust Co's estimates of a roughly $8 billion daily add need, said Marc Wanshel, economist.
Wanshel said the Fed already had in place for Wednesday (settlement day) a base of $10.8 billion via three- and 14-day fixed term RPs, which should keep settlement pressures modest.
He saw the Fed arranging overnight RPs, but probably $3 billion or less in size.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663 ))
